brief:
A British man serving in the Israeli army posed for photographs in front of a burning Gaza school, according to a new film by Declassified UK. Jonathan Burman, who attended school in Manchester before enlisting, served in Gaza and was documented by the investigative outlet posing at the site of the destroyed structure.

The revelation comes as part of an ongoing examination by Declassified UK into British nationals fighting in the Israeli military during the Gaza conflict.
dek: British man in Israeli army posed in front of burning Gaza school, new film reveals Submitted by Imran Mulla on Mon, 10/12/2026 - 15:35 Jonathan Burman went to school in Manchester before joining Israeli army and serving in Gaza, Declassified UK finds…
title: British soldier poses before burning Gaza school in documentary footage
